user.title: Boiler Monitor
user.description: Choose the entity that tells when the burner is firing, plus the optional temperature sensors. Every sensor except the burner is optional; features that need a missing sensor are simply not created.

data_description.burner_entity: binary_sensor / switch / input_boolean (relay or flame), climate (uses hvac_action), or a text sensor.
data_description.burner_on_state: Usually 'on'. For a climate entity: the hvac_action value, e.g. 'heating'. For a text sensor: its exact state.
data_description.season_entity: If set, monitoring pauses while this entity is not in the state below. Leave empty to monitor always.
data_description.season_state: e.g. 'on', 'heat', or the option text of an input_select.
data_description.indoor_temp_entities: Average of the available sensors is used for the heating-effect check.

abort.already_configured: This burner entity is already monitored.

data_description.notify_service: e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone (or a notify entity). Empty = no push alerts (events and binary sensors still work).
data_description.min_burn_seconds: Relay glitches shorter than this are discarded.
data_description.csv_log: Appends events to /config/boiler_monitor/ (one CSV file per boiler)

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Limit to these config entries (empty = all).
